verdict.rationale: Claude Design can import a team's design system, via /design-sync or a codebase, and apply it to every project automatically. It also offers Claude-generated sliders for tuning spacing and color, which loosely covers shared styling across designs. However, no evidence shows a first-class token or variable manager with modes or themes. The one community report of design-system tokens describes tokens built inside PenPot via MCP, not managed within Claude Design itself. Missing for 10: explicit token/variable management UI for colors, spacing, and typography; mode or theme switching (e.g. light/dark) applied across designs; typography token handling; first-party docs or hands-on corroboration of token editing.
